variants.question: Can this ordinary moment stand on its own without an achievement or photograph?

post.text: New dinner rule from the kids: everyone tells one tiny good thing from their day. Tonight’s winner was finding a ladybug.

variants.name: A longer reflection
variants.question: Does Read more preserve a coherent beginning and expand without hiding actions?

post.text: Tonight we tried going for a walk without deciding where we were headed. At the first corner, the kids voted left. At the next one, someone spotted a cat and the route changed again. We stopped to watch the water in the gutter, counted porch swings, and debated which tree would make the best clubhouse. Nothing particularly remarkable happened. But nobody asked for a screen, and we got home talking about doing it again. I want to remember that making room for family time does not always mean planning something impressive. Sometimes it just means putting our shoes on and leaving a little room for surprise.

replyPreview.text: Leaving room for surprise is the part I needed to hear.
